test_remote_eval: test the remote evaluation by launching a standalone agent and a remote evaluator in separate processes
run_standalone_agent: run a standalone simuleval agent on a specified port with a user-defined agent class
run_remote_evaluation: run a remote simuleval evaluation against a standalone agent using source and target files
find_free_port: find a free network port for use with simuleval remote evaluation
launch_multiprocess_eval: launch simuleval remote evaluation using multiprocessing with separate agent and evaluator processes
